*Found two issues to fix before merge:*

1. *Incorrect extension parsing* — `src/extension.js:2`
   Uses the second dot-separated segment without lowercasing, contrary to the README’s contract. Verified: `Archive.TAR.GZ` returns `TAR`, `photo.JPG` falls back to octet-stream, and `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly becomes `image/jpeg`. Dotless names also return `undefined` instead of `''`.
   *Recommended fix:* extract the text after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` for missing/trailing extensions; add regression tests.

2. *Inherited properties bypass the MIME fallback* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES[...]` reads the object’s prototype. Verified: `file.constructor` returns a function and `file.__proto__` returns an object—not a MIME string or the documented fallback.
   *Recommended fix:* use an own-property lookup, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`; test these filenames.

All 3 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these cases. Reviewed `upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4` against `main`; no files changed.
